canvas_base.description: The educator's Canvas host, e.g. https://school.instructure.com. Non-secret connector config, visible to the agent.

moodle_base.description: The educator's Moodle host, e.g. https://moodle.school.edu. Non-secret connector config, visible to the agent.

canvas_pat.description: Educator self-generated Canvas personal access token (Account > Settings > Approved Integrations). Lane 1 express auth. Full-permission bearer token: treated as crown jewels.

moodle_sesskey.description: Moodle sesskey scraped at sign-in time. A per-session CSRF value visible in page content; readable by the agent for inclusion in request bodies and query strings. Rotates only when the session rotates.

description: Product pin set for Morrow for Muse. v1 ships the Chromium lane with no multi-step manifest entries: `entries` is intentionally empty (fail-closed: `execute --entry` refuses every entry name until entries are pinned here with sha256 verified against in-dist manifests). NOTE (2026-09-21): the 14 sha256 pins that used to live here were REMOVED, not re-pointed, because every pinned path pointed OUTSIDE the carved tree (../provision/manifests/*, ../catalog/a11y/*, ../../gap-audit/f13-test-manifest.json). In the shipped artifact those pins were unverifiable by the educator and protected nothing; shipping them implied a guarantee the dist could not keep.

rules: Frozen plans: every write dispatches under a frozen plan digest; plan/action mismatch refuses.
Catalog enforcement: only operations marked live-proven in proof-battery/OPERATION_CATALOG.md dispatch. Nothing overrides that, not even the educator asking.
Approvals: writes require an educator-signed approval record, digest-bound to the exact action, unexpired, category-scoped, and unused. An approval is consumed before the network call.
Journaling: every dispatch appends one record; consumed op ids are never reused.
Session death: nothing is journaled; unjournaled op ids (never consumed) stay reusable. A retry needs a freshly signed approval and re-sign-in through the login helper.
Write halt: if ~/.morrow/write_halt exists, all writes refuse.
Fail closed: 4xx fails fast; uncertain writes are never retried.

Learner data: operations whose responses carry people dispatch only on the Chromium lane with the encrypted learner vault, de-identified before the agent or the journal sees them; every other lane refuses them. Nothing is gated or restricted by tenant (parity law).
Scope: v1 is Canvas-only. Blackboard is an honestly-disclosed roadmap item, not a ship criterion.

name: morrow-for-muse-product
